projects.title: CUNY NYC Open Data Lab
projects.summary: An open-source, browser-based research workspace for turning official NYC Open Data into interactive Python investigations.
projects.details: Combines NYC dataset discovery, JupyterLite, private investigation folders, direct data loading, and a submission and review workflow.

projects.title: LANG — The Semantic Shell
projects.summary: A Rust-based natural-language interface that translates plain-English intent into local Linux and WSL system actions.
projects.details: Supports common file and folder operations and runs locally with a private inference engine. Source remains private pending a future security review.

projects.title: Bridge
projects.summary: A secure internship engagement platform built for BMCC's Internship and Experiential Learning Office.
projects.details: Centralizes student records, events, registration, check-in, follow-ups, reports, employer relationships, and student visits.

projects.title: Private Career Workspace
projects.summary: A private workspace that organizes job-search activity, notes, files, and supporting tools in one place.
projects.details: Designed to reduce fragmented workflows and make career planning easier to track and maintain.

projects.title: BitWise Studio
projects.summary: A browser-based tool for binary, hexadecimal, and decimal conversion with input validation.
projects.details: Applies computing concepts related to number systems and data representation through a responsive interface.
